## Checklist

- [ ] I added exactly one entry to `awesome.json` (or this is a removal or a fix).
- [ ] The repository is at least 3 months old, not archived, not a fork, has a license, and is written in Go.
- [ ] The description says what the project does, starts uppercase, ends with a period, and avoids marketing words.
- [ ] I ran `go run ./cmd/awesome fmt && go run ./cmd/awesome validate` and both passed.
- [ ] I did not touch `README.md`, `metadata.json` or `badges/`; they are generated.
